editorial:
Imagine checking into a cozy little hotel in Spain, only to find out the hosts are actually nightmare fuel. You get two sisters who act like sweet, religious ladies, but they have a dark secret. They hate any woman who doesn't follow their strict rules about morality and sex. If they think you are too wild or sinful, they won't just ask you to leave; they will kill you in the most brutal ways possible. It feels like a creepy trap where the beautiful scenery just makes the violence feel even more shocking.

What really works here is how the movie builds tension before the gore hits. The acting is solid, and the twists keep you guessing about who will survive the night. It does move a bit slow in some spots, but the kills make up for it. You should definitely watch this if you love old-school slashers with a weird twist. For the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection so you can see all the gritty details in high quality.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a bloody showdown as the secrets of the sisters finally come out. After a series of kills, the cycle of violence peaks when the survivors fight back against the religious fanatics. Most of the killers meet a grim end, showing that their obsession with purity only led to death. It wraps up by proving that the sisters were the real monsters all along, leaving you with a cold feeling as the credits roll.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 70s horror and scary hotel stories.
